info.name: HVOps API
info.description:
Hybrid Virtualization Ops Platform - every public endpoint.

## Getting started
1. Select the **HVOps local** environment (postman/hvops.postman_environment.json).
2. Run **Auth / Login**. It stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` as collection
   variables, so everything after it is authenticated automatically.
3. Run **Sources / List sources** and copy an id into `sourceId`, then
   **Inventory / List VMs** and copy an id into `vmId`. The requests that need an
   id read these variables.

Roles are ordered admin > operator > viewer; each request notes what it needs.
The `/internal/*` endpoints are deliberately absent: they are service-to-service
only, authenticated with `X-Service-Token`, and excluded from the OpenAPI schema.
